# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 36 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 37 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_036_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 36

**1** Jesus said: "Do not worry [рмееуе] from morning [шоуеіт] to evening and from evening to morning about what you will wear [шк]."

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- *рмееуе*: to worry, be anxious; literally "do not care/think about"
- *шоуеіт*: morning
- *шк*: to wear, put on clothing; the basic covering
- The Coptic version is shorter than the Synoptic parallel
- P.Oxy 655 (cols. i-ii) has a significantly longer Greek version adding food, body, and lilies-of-the-field
- The Coptic version mentions only clothing; the P.Oxy version mentions clothing, food, height, lilies
- cf. Matt 6:25-34; Luke 12:22-31 — the anxiety-about-provisions passage
